text:
Let me analyze this question carefully.

The key facts are:
- Serial killer who hanged himself in Wakefield Prison
- January 2004
- Found guilty of 15 murders
- Four years after conviction (so convicted around 2000)

Harold Shipman was a British doctor and serial killer who was convicted in January 2000 of murdering 15 patients (though the actual number of victims is believed to be much higher, possibly over 200). He was sentenced to life imprisonment and sent to Wakefield Prison, where he hanged himself on January 13, 2004 - exactly four years after his conviction.

Dennis Nilsen was also a British serial killer, but he was convicted in 1983 of six murders and two attempted murders, and he died in prison in 2018 (not 2004), and not at Wakefield Prison initially.

The details match Harold Shipman
